t: The $(5)Translation Module$() can be placed in the field slots of the $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() to offset the projected field's position. You can move the force field in each direction by placing $(5)Translation Module$()s in the respective field slot for that side. Each module moves the field by 1 block.
$(5)位移模块$()可被置入$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()的力场插槽中，以偏移投射力场的位置。您可通过在对应方向的力场插槽中放置$(5)位移模块$()，使力场沿各方向移动。每个模块可使力场移动1个方块。
